risks.summary: Production realm stays pinned; an explicit isolated CI build is now admitted, but real authenticated E2E configuration and verification remain blocked
Canonical file fallback removed; legacy cached/public objects not migrated and full private R2/staging durability/quota acceptance remains blocked

Absent durable billing credentials activates process-only cycles/reservations; quota also falls back after DB/RPC errors. Guest rate/token/concurrency/claim limits fall back from Redis to maps. UniversalCostLedger is explicitly in-process; BillingService also defines process-only fulfilled-payment deduplication. Restart/cross-process accounting cannot rely on these stores
Run persistence returns without service-role configuration and scheduled writes swallow failures; hot run maps are not durable evidence of saved history

universalStore defaults to owner-keyed memory without a client; runtime-store and operational evidence/idempotency map implementations also exist. Durable production admission/caller reachability must be proved, not inferred from class names
OAuth/PKCE plaintext DB/private JSON mirror; encryption, expiry, one-use and KMS cutover need verified migration
Four queue definitions, no discovered Worker consumers; client construction is not queue readiness

BYOK AES-GCM exists; encryptionKey can derive from platform service-role/JWT credentials and has a fixed development fallback guarded only by NODE_ENV. Actual managed production key authority/AAD/rotation is not established; no key values were read
Observed main and Production/Preview lack platform protection/restrictions; mandatory user release gates still apply
Vercel project configured Node 24.x; canonical CI/API image is 22.21.1; Fly host test workflow has no explicit setup-node
